name: Jar with Cover
material: porcelaneous stoneware with blue glaze and splashes of purple, Jun ware
dimensions: Diameter: 12.1 cm (4 3/4 in.); Overall: 9.5 cm (3 3/4 in.)
summary: The beauty of Jun ware lies in its spectacular glaze effects, which provide immediate visual appeal. The glaze that is thickly applied onto the heavily potted body also lends the vessel a sense of volume. As shown here, its glaze colors range from soft milky-blue to rose-purple.
